scope: Passive HTTPS/TLS/header/path checks and local source/dependency review; not a penetration test

local_checks.pip_audit: No known vulnerabilities found in requirements.txt

tracked_production_source_secret_scan.review: A test-only password literal and a placeholder API key in a hidden documentation example; neither is an active credential.

broad_workspace_secret_scan.review: 73 generic matches were test fixtures, examples, or old audit scripts. Seven private-key blocks were found: six generated pytest certificate fixtures plus the workspace TLS key at deploy/certs/privkey.pem. That TLS key is ignored by Git and excluded from the Docker build context; it was not tracked. The workspace still contains this local deployment secret, so keep the workspace private. No secret values were copied into evidence.

local_checks.gitleaks_ci: Configured in .github/workflows/secrets.yml using v8.24.2. Full-history scan of the new sanitized mirror via the CI container scanned 49 commits (~159 MB) and returned no leaks using the current workspace config; narrow allowlists cover reviewed documentation placeholders and synthetic test values. The config edits are uncommitted and the final mirror must be rebuilt and rescanned after commit.
local_checks.docker_image_tls_key_check: The production image does not contain /app/deploy/certs/privkey.pem.
